title: FIRAI Forensic Readiness Measure
description: A proactive capability or evidence-preservation practice, put in place before an incident, that enables or strengthens a later forensic investigation. Readiness measures are not investigative techniques: R0008 preserves a behavioral baseline, while T0404 performs the deviation analysis.

type.description: strengthen: extends an existing classical control (logging, version control, configuration management, asset inventory, signing, supplier contracts) to cover AI. new: an AI-specific control with no classical counterpart.
